Steps 2.1–2.2 rewrite total entropy as a constant minus the constrained potential divided by T0; the global-minimum conclusion is explicitly conditional on an attained entropy maximum.

Steps 1.1–1.2 combine the stated work-store energy balance, ideal bath entropy and isolated-composite second law to bound Q, then rearrange the first law to obtain Wout≤−ΔG; equality is not claimed attainable.

Steps 1.1–1.2 derive Cv and Cp as T times entropy-temperature derivatives and use the Helmholtz Maxwell relation plus the total-derivative chain rule. Steps 2.1–2.2 differentiate the valid pressure inverse and substitute alpha_p and kappa_T definitions.
